svg.desc: WTP Steel Buildings (VEOLIA) LOCATION Helwan, Egypt CLIENT VEOLIA COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2017 N/A DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2017 in Helwan, this project involved the design and development of steel buildings for a water and wastewater treatment plant. BECT provided architectural and multidisciplinary engineering design, tender documents, site supervision and project management to support efficient industrial operations. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management.
